detail.longDescription: I’ve been running openim.nl as a free XMPP server for a while now and we just crossed 150+ daily active users. I want to keep the server fast, independent, and completely ad-free for the long run, so I finally put together a couple of optional paid tiers to help cover the hosting bills. ​Free accounts aren't going anywhere. ​But if you want more storage and a bigger offline message queue, you can now grab a Supporter upgrade for €10/year. # xmpp # SelfHosted # DeGoogle # BuyFromEU
